status.main_product: Commercial soft serve ice cream machines and slushy machines
status.scope_reason: The company manufactures and sells commercial soft-serve ice cream machines under its own GSEICE brand name.
status.evidence: According to the official GSEICE website contact page, the trade name GSEICE is operated by Zhongshen Technology (Guangdong) Co., Ltd., based in Foshan, China.

claims.claim: The company reports that its soft-serve machines, such as configurations equipped with an Embraco R290 high-efficiency compressor, utilize a fast-freezing process where the initial batch is prepared in 10 minutes and subsequent batches take 4 to 6 minutes, according to the GSEICE Ice Cream Maker Machine User Manual.
claims.source: GSEICE Soft Serve Ice Cream Machine User Manual (manuals.plus/asin/B0DDC9F36D)

claims.claim: The company reports that its ST32RELW commercial soft-serve model operates with independent dual refrigeration systems and features adjustable overrun control to manage product fluffiness, according to the official GSEICE company blog.
claims.source: GSEICE Ice Cream Machine Official Blog (gseice.com/blogs/ice-cream-machine)

claims.claim: The company's official B2B bulk purchase catalog lists multiple specific series designations for its ice cream machine portfolio, including the BJW, BH, BHT, BX, BX-T, BJK, BT, BHH, BK, BQ, and GQ series.
claims.source: GSEICE Bulk Purchase (B2B) Catalog (gseice.com/pages/bulk-purchase-b2b)

claims.claim: The company reports a direct commercial catalog featuring countertop soft-serve machine models including the ST16RE, ST16RELW, and GT16RE single-flavor units, alongside dual-flavor/twist multi-flavor systems such as the ST32RELW and BH488C.
claims.source: GSEICE Official Collections (gseice.com/collections/soft-serve-ice-cream-machine)

claims.claim: The company reports that its 3600W Commercial Ice Cream Machine yields an hourly throughput of 42–46 liters (11–12.2 gallons), delivering up to 450 servings per hour, according to product specifications published on Amazon.
claims.source: GSEICE 3600W Commercial Ice Cream Machine Specifications on Amazon (amazon.in/dp/B0DCJHYRXH)

claims.claim: The company reports in the GSEICE Soft Serve Ice Cream Machine User Manual that initial batch molding requires 8–10 minutes, whereas subsequent recovery formations between cycles take 4–6 minutes.
claims.source: GSEICE Soft Serve Ice Cream Machine User Manual (manuals.plus/asin/B0DDC9F36D)

claims.claim: The company reports that its 2500W Commercial Ice Cream Maker Machine reaches an hourly yield of 26–32 liters (6.8–8.4 gallons), which accommodates up to 300 servings hourly, according to product data on Amazon.
claims.source: GSEICE 2500W Commercial Ice Cream Maker Machine product details on Amazon / Ubuy (ubuy.co.in/product/541UXUFIW-gseice-commercial-ice-cream-maker-mchine-10-inch-lcd-touch-screen-dual-system-independent-operation-6-8-to-8-4-gal-h-soft-serve-machine-with)

claims.claim: The company reports that its ST-13BAW single-flavor soft serve ice cream maker delivers a production capacity of 3.5 gallons per hour, according to product listings on Ubuy.
claims.source: GSEICE ST-13BAW product listings on Ubuy (ubuy.co.in/product/TMCTN83WI-gseice-soft-serve-ice-cream-machine)

claims.claim: The company reports that its ST16E commercial ice cream machine provides an output capacity of 4.2 to 4.8 gallons per hour, which equals approximately 40 to 56 pieces of 80-gram portions per hour, according to the GSEICE Ice Cream Maker Machine User Manual.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its ST16E commercial ice cream machine provides an output capacity of 4.2 to 4.6 gallons per hour, which equals approximately 40 to 56 pieces of 80-gram portions per hour, according to the GSEICE Ice Cream Maker Machine User Manual.
claims.source: GSEICE Soft Serve Ice Cream Machine User Manual (manuals.plus/asin/B0DDC9F36D)

claims.claim: The company reports that its soft-serve ice cream machines feature advanced frequency conversion technology that saves electricity bills by up to 2/3 compared to ordinary commercial ice cream makers.
claims.note: The precise claim that the machine saves electricity bills by up to 2/3 compared to ordinary commercial ice cream makers could not be found in published specifications, manuals, or official company product releases.
claims.source: GSEICE Official Store and product documentation

claims.claim: A product specification document for the GSEICE Commercial Soft Serve Ice Cream Machine confirms the use of an Embraco R290 high-efficiency compressor.
claims.source: Amazon Product Listing (GSEICE Commercial Independent Countertop Refrigeration Machine with Embraco R290 compressor)

claims.claim: Retailer documentation lists an alternative high-capacity commercial variant equipped with R410a refrigerant designed for faster cooling.
claims.source: Amazon Product Listing (GSEICE 3600W Commercial Ice Cream Machine equipped with R410a refrigerant)

claims.claim: The company reports that its soft serve ice cream machines integrate advanced frequency conversion technology that reduces electricity consumption by up to two-thirds compared to ordinary commercial ice cream machines.
claims.source: GSEICE Commercial Ice Cream Maker Machine User Manual & Desertcart Product Listing

claims.claim: The company reports that its commercial soft-serve ice cream machines, including the ST16RELW and ST16RE models, feature electronic control setups including 5-inch and 7-inch LCD touchscreens for executing automated functions such as freeze, wash, defrosting, pre-cooling, and hardness adjustment, as documented in the official GSEICE Product Manuals.
claims.source: GSEICE Official Blog ("Best Soft Ice Cream Machines for Beginners"), GSEICE Unboxing Video, & GSEICE User Manual

claims.claim: The company reports that its high-capacity commercial models, such as the ST32RELW 3-flavor machine, are built with an integrated 10-inch smart LCD touch control panel to manage dual independent refrigeration systems, as disclosed on the official GSEICE Brand Channel.
claims.source: GSEICE Official Blog ("Best Soft Ice Cream Machines for Beginners") & Desertcart Product Listing

claims.claim: The company reports that its soft-serve units include automated digital diagnostic alarms, such as an integrated low-mix alert display, to monitor hopper ingredient levels during operation, as specified in the GSEICE BH488C Equipment Documentation.
claims.source: GSEICE BH488C Equipment Documentation (Manuals+)

claims.claim: The company exports its soft-serve refrigeration equipment globally from Guangdong, China, with a sales distribution of Southeast Asia (46.67%), South America (20.00%), the Middle East (13.33%), Africa (6.67%), North America (6.67%), and Southern Europe (6.66%), according to its commercial supplier profile.
claims.source: GSEICE Alibaba / Official Commercial Profiles

claims.claim: The company offers after-sales infrastructure consisting of a dedicated U.S. phone service line (+1 2135785666) and 24-hour support email communication to handle equipment issues, according to the official GSEICE Contact portal.
claims.source: Official GSEICE Contact Portal (://gseice.com)

claims.claim: The company fulfills international product regulatory demands across its geographic markets by securing region-specific compliance certifications, including ETL and NSF for North America, CE for Europe, and SABER for the Middle East, as listed in its official product documentation.
claims.source: GSEICE Official Site (gseice.com)

claims.claim: Guangzhou Guangshen Electric Produce Co., Ltd. (the manufacturer of GSEICE) operates three manufacturing bases across Guangzhou, Foshan, and Xianning, China, with a total facility area of 80,000 square meters, according to corporate profiles on BossGoo and Alibaba.

claims.claim: The company reports a production capacity of 50,000 sets per year for soft ice cream machines and customized refrigeration products at its Guangzhou facility, according to its supplier profile.

claims.claim: The company's specialized Guangzhou factory occupies 12,000 square meters of facility space equipped with dedicated assembly lines, a testing center, and CNC machinery, according to its profile.

claims.claim: The trademark GSEICE is owned by Guangzhou Guangshen Electric Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (also operating as Guangzhou Guangshen Electric Produce Co., Ltd.), which was established in 2005 according to Justia Trademarks and corporate video documentation.

claims.claim: The manufacturing parent company reports a registered capital of 12.1 million for its production bases, including Guangzhou Guangshen Electric Produce Co., Ltd. and Guangshen Electric (Hubei) Co., Ltd., according to its corporate profile.
claims.source: Alibaba Company Profile for Guangzhou Guangshen Electric Produce Co., Ltd. (https://guangshen.en.alibaba.com/company_profile.html)

claims.claim: The brand's online commercial store operations are managed by Zhongshen Technology (Guangdong) Co., Ltd., as published on the official GSEICE Website.
claims.source: Official GSEICE Website About Us Page (https://www.gseice.com/pages/about-us)

claims.claim: The company reports its parent manufacturing facility, Guangshen, spans a total area of 60,000 square meters.
claims.source: Guangzhou Guangshen Electric Produce Co., Ltd. Company Profile on Alibaba (https://guangshen.en.alibaba.com/company_profile.html)

claims.claim: The company reports that its BW series high-end ice cream machines entered the McDonald's and KFC market segments in May 2011, according to the official corporate history of Guangzhou Guangshen Electric Produce Co., Ltd.
claims.note: Whether the BW series high-end ice cream machines entered the McDonald's and KFC market segments in May 2011.
